statement.p: Find dy/dx in terms of x and y if \arcsin(x^{7} y) = x y^{7}.

static.solution: x. \frac{1}{\sqrt{1 - x^{14} y^2}} (7 x^{6} y + x^{7} \frac{dy}{dx}) = y^{7} + 7 x y^{6} \frac{dy}{dx}, so, clearing the denominator, 7 x^{6} y + x^{7} \frac{dy}{dx} = \sqrt{1 - x^{14} y^2} (y^{7} + 7 x y^{6} \frac{dy}{dx}). Thus ( x^{7} - (7 x y^{6}) \sqrt{1 - x^{14} y^2} ) \frac{dy}{dx} = y^{7} \sqrt{1 - x^{14} y^2} - 7 x^{6} y, and finally \frac{dy}{dx} = \frac{y^{7} \sqrt{1 - x^{14} y^2} - 7 x^{6} y}{x^{7} - (7 x y^{6}) \sqrt{1 - x^{14} y^2}}.
